g.text: PayWise — End-to-End Financial Action Safety Lifecycle
(Manual User Entry or AI Agent Draft)
Clone State into Virtual Memory Sandbox
Calculate Projected State S' = f(S, A)
Load Active Policy Definitions & Parameters P
Evaluate Deterministic Rules R = g(S, S', A, P)
(Reserve check, duplicate invoices, budget limits, split detection, etc.)
Generate Structured Findings with Explanations & Actions
(Before vs After, Outflows, Policy Violations, Warnings)
(Record Proposal Hash, Preview Hash, Ledger Hash, Policy Hash)
1. Reload Latest Ledger State from SQLite
2. Reload Latest Active Policies from SQLite
3. Verify Proposal Hash Unchanged (Detect Post-Approval Tamper)
4. Verify Required Approval is Present & Decision == APPROVED
5. Verify Ledger State Hash Matches Approved Preview Hash
6. Verify Policy Set Hash Matches Approved Preview Hash
8. Re-evaluate Policy Rules on Fresh State
Set Proposal Status to STALE or BLOCKED
Require New Simulation Preview & Fresh Approval
Deduct Ledger Balance with Optimistic Concurrency Lock
(UPDATE accounts SET current_balance = ?, version = version + 1 WHERE version = ?)
Mark Invoices as PAID in Payables Ledger
Insert Unique Simulated Commit Record (Enforce Idempotency)
Present Successful Commit Confirmation & Updated Balance
